description: Calculate the recommended battery bank size based on daily energy consumption. Accounts for days of autonomy (how many days without charging) and depth of discharge. Returns required capacity, number of batteries, and wiring configuration.

dailyConsumptionWh.description: Daily energy consumption in watt-hours (from calculate_power_budget)

daysOfAutonomy.description: Days the system should run without any charging (default: 2)

depthOfDischargePercent.description: Usable percentage of battery capacity. LiFePO4: 80-90%, AGM: 50%, Gel: 50% (default: 80)

singleBatteryAh.description: Capacity of a single battery in amp-hours (e.g. 100, 200)

singleBatteryVoltage.description: Voltage of a single battery (e.g. 12.8 for LiFePO4, 12 for lead-acid)

name: calculate_battery_bank
title: Battery Bank Sizing Calculator
